name: PT Steady Safe Tbk
summary: PT Steady Safe Tbk provides bus transportation services in Indonesia. The company operates through the Land Transportation and Financial Services segments. It is also involved in the provision of financing, limousine rental, and taxi services. The company was formerly known as PT. Tanda Widjaja Sakti and changed its name to PT Steady Safe Tbk in December 1993. PT Steady Safe Tbk was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Steady Safe Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Infiniti Wahana.
